tools.name: fluid_state
tools.description: A fluid's state from two properties, with CoolProp: T, P, h, s, x, v, and "properties" (D density, u, cp, cv, mu viscosity, k conductivity, Pr, Z, a speed of sound, g). state: "T = 25 °C, P = 1 bar", "P = 1 MPa, sat vapor". Processes and cycles: solve_worksheet.

tools.name: solve_worksheet
tools.description:
Solves processes and whole cycles with CoolProp, written as a Thermoprops Worksheet script. Answers a table of the states, the printed results, errors by line, and a link that opens it solved with diagrams: give it to the user.

One statement per line, # comments:
fluid R134a
units celsius

tools.name: language_reference
tools.description: The script language's whole manual, for what solve_worksheet's cheat sheet leaves out.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "solve_worksheet" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.
